tagline: Información para vivir, participar y entender Oregon.
secondary_message: Noticias, recursos, leyes e información pública en español para nuestra comunidad.

anti_patterns: NO sitio de entretenimiento o sensacionalista
NO partidismo político (evitar rojo republicano dominante vs azul demócrata)
NO uso de Inter o Space Grotesk para titulares principal/secundarios
NO layouts apretados sin aire; priorizar espacio en blanco amplio

hero_section.style: Clean, spacious institutional header banner with deep Oregon green primary framing, high-contrast search input '¿Qué información estás buscando?' with quick category pill filters (Vivienda, Leyes, Salud, Empleo, Inmigración, Elecciones 2026).

elements: Category badge in muted earth tone
Leer más link with arrow icon

resource_grid_items.style: Soft warm beige/stone background (#F2EBE1/dark:bg-stone-800) card with forest green icon circle, crisp typography, hover border highlight.

oregon_te_informa_cards.style: Institutional explanatory accordion or structured step-by-step card with high-legibility badges and direct links to official state websites (.gov).

elections_2026_module.style: Strictly non-partisan candidate and ballot measure side-by-side comparison table. Equal width columns, identical neutral layout, plain language breakdown of proposals without opinionated language.

cms_admin_dashboard.style: High-density functional dashboard using crisp slate dark/light UI, collapsible sidebar, live metric cards, rich article editor with built-in AI Spanish clarity assistant, source verification tracker, and workflow approval status.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use data-testid attribute on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, search).
Ensure dark/light theme switching works cleanly with CSS variables or Tailwind dark: classes.
Implement rich Spanish editorial content with realistic Oregon civic news, housing guides, legal updates, and election comparison views.
Use Lucide icons or Phosphor icons for category icons.
Ensure WCAG AA contrast standard compliance (min 4.5:1 ratio for standard text).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.header_requirement: Headers must not have completely transparent backgrounds when scrolled; use backdrop-blur and semi-opaque fill.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography_rule: Rotated font genres: Lora/Georgia for headings, Work Sans/Plus Jakarta Sans for body text.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility_rule: Follow WCAG AA contrast standards across all themes.
